name: napoleon-edit
description: Napoleon Bonaparte 1769–1821 — vertical cinematic history edit built with Remotion

scripts.audio: python3 scripts/make_audio.py && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/audio/main-track.wav -b:a 256k public/audio/main-track.mp3 && rm public/audio/main-track.wav && node scripts/scan-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run scan && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run scan && remotion render src/index.ts NapoleonEdit out/napoleon_edit.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=20 --x264-preset=slow --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.audio:score: python3 scripts/make_score.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/audio/main-track.wav -b:a 256k public/audio/main-track.mp3 && rm public/audio/main-track.wav && node scripts/scan-assets.mjs
scripts.audio:hyper: python3 scripts/make_hyper.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/audio/main-track.wav -b:a 256k public/audio/main-track-hyper.mp3 && rm public/audio/main-track.wav && node scripts/scan-assets.mjs
